name: unclaimedgrant
description: Static site generator, matching engine and Cloudflare Worker for unclaimedgrant.com. No runtime dependencies by design — the whole thing is plain Node and plain Web APIs.

scripts.test: EMIT_FULL_DATASET=1 node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/test-dashboard.mjs && node scripts/test-gating.mjs && node scripts/test-admin.mjs && node scripts/test-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/test-autoapply.mjs && node scripts/test-auth.mjs && node scripts/test-deadlines.mjs && node scripts/test-vocabulary.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@latest deploy
